title: Nutrition — the image, and the build now on dev
question: The approved image, and the built screen as it now runs on dev: the top, scrolled down, and in Hebrew. Say what is still off, or approve.

options.label: Built: the top
options.thesis: Large 'Today', the date, the day arrows and History / Today / Recipes / Profile in glass, then the tubes.
options.viewport: Kept the History / Recipes / Profile tabs so nothing loses its way in.
options.risk: The image has no tabs; they stay until they have a new home.

options.label: Built: scrolled
options.thesis: Water, ask-about-food and today's meals as glass panels under a frosted header.
options.viewport: Water keeps its three quick amounts.
options.risk: The image shows one water pill with a single +.

options.label: Built: in Hebrew
options.thesis: Mirrored right to left, the scales move to the inside of each tube.
